infobox.usage: Unlocks the operating room at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Operating room key (OR) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the operating room with broadcasting equipment, located somewhere at the water treatment plant.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Broadcast - Part 1

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text:
- Building #1 at the water treatment plant, in the laboratories on the first floor.

- Building #2 at the water treatment plant, on the desk in the western office.

- Building #2 at the water treatment plant, on a desk in the left hand upstairs office.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: At the ground floor of office building #1, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north of Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Electronics)
- 1x Medbag
- 1x Dead Scav
